description: Assigns notes to the channels of a polyphonic voice — so envelope tails can ring out

params.text: How many channels to cycle through; the oldest is reused when they run out

inputs.text: Each gate at GATE hands the pitch at V/OCT to a poly channel, with a matching gate on the same channel

outputs.text: Each gate at GATE hands the pitch at V/OCT to a poly channel, with a matching gate on the same channel

notes: with a polyphonic input it reassigns instead, so the in and out channel counts can differ

inputs.2: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
